status: declared before any correlation was computed; committed in the same commit as the stage 3 results and before stage 4 ran
why_exploratory: the inherited depth gate is likely to refuse this pair: the logged trial E6 table already records the fibroblast activation score against fibroblast depth at rho 0.4116 and fibroblast EGFR at 0.4918, and both members of the new pair are fibroblast detection fractions. No alpha is claimed and no decision is attached.
question: whether the fibroblast activation programme tracks the recipient's post-receptor integrin and latent-complex genes more closely than it tracks epithelial ligand abundance
not_the_question: recipient licensing as a whole. The cited mechanism makes recipient EGFR obligatory and A9 owns the receptor layer, so EGFR is deliberately absent from the predictor and the estimand is the layer below it.

instrument_reused_unchanged_from_trial_e.donors: Subject_Identity, restricted to Disease_Identity in IPF and Control; COPD out of scope
instrument_reused_unchanged_from_trial_e.measure: the fraction of cells with a non-zero count
instrument_reused_unchanged_from_trial_e.depth_measure: median deposited nGene per cell, per donor and compartment
instrument_reused_unchanged_from_trial_e.inherited: the rules and the gene lists, not a claim that any earlier result transfers

outcome.name: fibroblast activation score
outcome.note: the same list trial E6 froze, scored the same way in the same cells

predictor.name: recipient machinery composite
predictor.aggregation: the mean of the member detection fractions in the same fibroblasts, one composite, computed per donor
predictor.eligibility_rule: a member enters the composite only if its pooled fibroblast detection fraction across eligible donors is at least the floor; any member excluded is named in the run record, as MC4 requires

comparator.name: epithelial AREG detection
comparator.why: the abundance predictor that trial E6 already tested and that C50 grades Not established; the comparison is between predictors, not a retest of that row

statistic.reported: rho, the nominal p, and the donor count, with the word exploratory attached to each

depth_rule_C51.rule: if both members of a pair correlate with their own compartment's depth at absolute rho of 0.4 or more, the pair is reported as confounded and is not read, whatever its own correlation
depth_rule_C51.consequence_declared_in_advance: refusal is a likely outcome and is itself the result

shared_detection_control.role: bounds the artefact of shared detection rate only, and is expected to be a low bar because these are near-saturated

co_regulation_control.why: TGFB1, THBS1, ITGB8 and LTBP1 are themselves TGF-beta inducible, so predictor and outcome are co-regulated programme members in the same cells; a detection control cannot bound that
co_regulation_control.candidate_universe: members of HALLMARK_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION, excluding any member of HALLMARK_TGF_BETA_SIGNALING or HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION
co_regulation_control.matching_rule: for each eligible machinery member, in the order declared above, take the unused candidate whose pooled fibroblast detection fraction is closest to that member's; ties broken by gene symbol
co_regulation_control.scoring: identical to the predictor, in the same cells
co_regulation_control.requirement: the machinery correlation must exceed this matched control's correlation, not only the housekeeping control's; otherwise the result is attributed to co-regulation and is not read as recipient state

controls_that_are_not_optional.disease_stratum: the IPF-only stratum reported beside the pooled result

mural_stratum.labels: Manuscript_Identity Pericyte, plus any deposited smooth-muscle label, named in the run record
mural_stratum.why: the cited mechanism used PDGFRB-positive pericytes, not lung fibroblasts, so the population it used is reported beside the one the E6 instrument selects
mural_stratum.expected_limit: the deposit holds 670 pericytes in total, so the 50-cell donor floor will leave few donors; an underpowered stratum is reported as underpowered

declared_reading.supported_observationally: the machinery composite predicts activation where epithelial AREG did not, the depth rule does not refuse the pair, and the correlation exceeds both controls; still correlational, with no direction and no proximity
declared_reading.not_visible: neither predictor tracks activation; the report states the smallest effect the donor count could have detected
declared_reading.rival_not_excluded: both predictors track activation comparably, or the matched control matches the machinery
declared_reading.refused: the depth rule refuses the pair; the refusal is the result

prohibited: reading any correlation as direction, proximity or mechanism
reading a positive result as recipient licensing, since the receptor layer is absent from the predictor
treating this as a retest of C49 or C50, or re-grading either
adding or grading a claim row
substituting a different predictor or outcome after any correlation is seen
